title: Mutation testing campaign on src/core: redundant tests and holes
summary: Specified: one-shot StrykerJS 10.1.1 run on src/core (just mutation-core) with a node:test per-test adapter and a whole-program TypeScript 7 checker; test/core decides redundancy, other layers label holes; lists redundant tests for the owner (nothing removed), adds tests for holes, writes the note.
